description: This file contains a unit test class 'MeanStddevNormalizationTest' that tests the mean and standard deviation normalization functionalities within the TensorFlow GPU delegate for Metal. It uses XCTest framework to run various test cases on batch normalization functions, testing different scenarios like zero mean, small variance, large variance, etc.

classes.name: MeanStddevNormalizationTest
classes.description: A XCTestCase subclass that tests the mean and standard deviation normalization functionalities for the TensorFlow Lite GPU delegate with Metal backend.

methods.name: testMeanStddevNormSeparateBatches
methods.description: Test batch normalization with various mean and variance configurations to ensure correctness.

methods.name: testMeanStddevNormalizationLargeVector
methods.description: Test batch normalization on large vectors to evaluate performance and correctness.
